ItemDescription.Value: Drill your army against itself: split your men into two teams through a picker screen, choose your side, and fight a mock battle on the real terrain of your map position. Nobody truly dies - the fallen wake up wounded (your surgeon softens the rest), the troops keep the XP they earned, and a cooldown gates the next drill. Plus the general's toolkit for drills AND real field battles: choose the battlefield, choose the hour, and ride out to scout any of those grounds alone - in a real encounter both armies stand frozen, so the lines you scout are the coming battle's true ones. Optional mock-enemy mode: compose a phantom force from every troop in the game and test your company against it. Configurable via MCM (optional) or config.json.
